public_rationale: The sentence is the speaker's hedged reading of a McKinsey survey: generative AI 'doesn't seem to be generating organizations money.' He gives no measure of 'generating money', no group of organizations, no period and no cutoff. Scoring it would mean picking those terms for him, for example organization-wide EBIT in 2023 with some prevalence threshold. Reviewers found that unfair in earlier drafts. Checking only whether the McKinsey numbers exist would test his source, not his inference. So the claim cannot fairly be marked true or false.
limitations: The primary McKinsey report could not be loaded, so even the underlying figures were not verified here.
The survey asks about AI in general, which makes any attempt to test a claim about generative AI shakier still.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI, though widely adopted, does not seem to be generating organizations money.

statement.excerpt: In plain English, this means that while generative AI is being shoved into plenty of places, it doesn't seem to be generating organizations money.

from_speaker: "generative AI is being shoved into plenty of places"
"it doesn't seem to be generating organizations money"
based on a McKinsey August 2023 survey: 55% adopted AI, 23% said more than 5% of EBIT came from AI, similar to 2022
our_interpretation: The sentence is the speaker's own gloss on survey figures he just quoted ('this means'). It is hedged ('doesn't seem'). It names no metric, no threshold for 'generating money', no set of organizations, and no period.

Turning it into a scored claim would mean supplying the metric (EBIT share? profit? revenue?), the population, the period and a cutoff for how many organizations must profit. The speaker gave none of these. Earlier drafts were found unfair for doing exactly that.
Checking only whether the McKinsey figures exist would test the cited data, not this sentence, which is an interpretation of that data.
So the claim is treated as a hedged interpretation that cannot be scored true or false.
criteria.support_condition: Not scorable. A scored version would need the speaker to name a measure and threshold, for example that most adopting organizations reported no measurable earnings gain from generative AI in 2023. He did not.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Not scorable for the same reason. No stated measure or threshold exists for evidence to contradict.
